meta.name: item-liquid-teleport
meta.author: namds666 & Claude Code & Codex
meta.description:
Cheat-grade Chrono blocks for global item and liquid transport, terrain and item conversion, repair, construction, overdrive, unit buffs and debuffs, mind control, and core placement, plus the Outpost, a base that builds mining drones.

[accent]v1.4.22[]
Outpost drones now mine the ore patch nearest your core that has a tile for every beam. Each drone takes its own tiles.

[accent]v1.4.21[]
New Chrono art: every block has its own glyph and a purple frame, and status icons show their stat. Boosters, buffers and debuffers use new items at once. Chrono Mender: flashes only on big hits. Chrono Repair Point: turns toward its target. Yuri: shows team colour, and conversions show a purple ring.

[accent]v1.4.20[]
Each Chrono Build Tower now takes its own plan from your build queue, so more towers build more blocks at the same time. They also build your plans when you are far away.

[accent]v1.4.19[]
Yuri's range is now 60 tiles, up from 30.

[accent]v1.4.18[]
Yuri now finds targets within its own 30 tile range around itself, so it keeps converting wherever it walks. Upgrades now only shorten the channel time.
